text: Priya: quick check — the kb link-scan after last deploy flagged ~17 orphan anchors and a few image 403s in /runtime/guide. anyone owning runtime-guide able to triage? Sam: @Priya can you drop the scan excerpt or a couple example paths? I can take a first pass if nobody else is owning it. :wave: Priya: thanks @Sam. example: https://kb.redwood.ai/runtime/guide#kv-cache-behavior and an image: /assets/runtime/kv-cache-arch.png -> 403. Full scan attached in the thread (see below). DocsBot: automated-scan: 2026-03-19T14:07Z — orphan-anchor-detected: 17; image-403: 4; affected-files: ["/runtime/guide.md", "/runtime/advanced-caching.md", "/runtime/kv-cache.md"] Jordan: fyi, we rotated a few anchors in the last doc cleanup PR (PR #4821) to normalize headings. probably a mismatch between old anchors and new ones. quick fix is to 1) add redirect anchors at old ids or 2) update inbound links. either ok depending on scale. Sam: leaning to adding small anchor redirects in-place (HTML anchors) for backward compat, then follow-up sweep for inbound link updates. avoids breaking external links. I'll open a tiny PR with sed script that inserts hidden anchors. sample command: ``` # add legacy anchor for 'kv-cache-behavior' sed -i "/## KV cache behavior/a\\" runtime/guide.md ``` Sam: will open draft PR and tag reviewers. ETA ~2h. @Elaine can you confirm CodeOwners for runtime files? want to ping correct owners. Elaine: runtime docs are CODEOWNERS'ed to @jordan and @mike, but we had opt-in for editorial changes last quarter. i'll add a note in the owners file to expect small compatibility anchor PRs and will ping product for any semantic changes. :+1: Priya: perfect. Sam — if you can also rehost the 403 images to our assets CDN (or re-generate with the new pipeline) and update img paths in the PR, that covers the image issues too. Sam: yeah i can rehost the 4 images. plan: 1) add anchor fixes 2) upload images to cdn bucket `documents-assets-runtime` and update paths 3) run link-scan locally and push. Jordan: add a changelog note in the PR body: "compat: restore legacy anchors, rehost runtime images (fix 403s)". Also add a quick unit test in the docs CI that runs the link-scan against changed files to avoid regressions. Priya: awesome. can someone add a quick card to the docs board under "runtime" and assign Sam? I can follow up with validation once PR is merged. Sam: will do the card + open PR now. ping here when it's ready for review. :rocket: DocsBot: reminder scheduled: nightly-scan will re-run 2026-03-20T03:00Z — new failures will create new threads. Elaine: thanks all. small asks like this are perfect for async fixes — appreciate the quick pickup. :heart:
